'''Moriales Systems''' was a company operating during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It produced the strong [[control cable]]s used to connect a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] cockpit to the vehicle's turbine engines. It was smaller than the dominating [[Steelton/Legends|Steelton]] company, but its [[SC-4.x control tether]] was popular in some parts of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="EV" />
